Geographies Served Programs Infrastructure Facilities District Aurangabad - Maharashtra State Maharashtra District Aurangabad - Maharashtra States Maharashtra Aarambh Society for Autism and Slow Learner Children has set up essential infrastructure to support its mission. With a dedicated headquarters office and a branch office equipped with a conference-cum-training hall, computer systems for documentation, and well-furnished halls, the organisation ensures a conducive environment. It also provides vehicles for transportation, hostel facilities for children, and maintains security through the installation of CCTV cameras. Additionally, the inclusion of a music room reflects the organisation's commitment to offering a holistic and enriching experience for the individuals it serves. Education Aid Facilities District Aurangabad - Maharashtra State Maharashtra District Aurangabad - Maharashtra States Maharashtra Aarambh Society provides comprehensive education aid facilities to support its initiatives. The organisation offers a well-equipped training hall with the necessary equipment, along with informative posters and charts for awareness. It employs models demonstrating different techniques, as well as utilizes audio-visual aids through TV-LCD, a digital photo camera, and an HD video camera for shooting. With the inclusion of an LCD projector featuring training aids, the organisation ensures effective and engaging educational sessions. Furthermore, it maintains a well-equipped therapy room and kitchen, emphasizing a holistic approach to education and care for its beneficiaries. Therapy Programme District Aurangabad - Maharashtra State Maharashtra District Aurangabad - Maharashtra States Maharashtra Aarambh Society offers a diverse range of therapeutic programmes. It provides dance therapy, physiotherapy, speech therapy, yoga therapy, and music therapy, all tailored to address the unique needs of individuals with autism and slow learning abilities. The inclusion of play therapy further underscores the organisation's commitment to employing varied and holistic approaches to enhance the well-being and development of the beneficiaries. Through these therapeutic interventions, Aarambh Society aims to create a supportive and nurturing environment for individuals facing these challenges, promoting their overall growth and quality of life. Art Zone Programme District Aurangabad - Maharashtra State Maharashtra District Aurangabad - Maharashtra States Maharashtra Aarambh Society through its dedicated vocational department, AARAMBH ART ZONE, focuses on fostering vocation, economic independence, and overall well-being for autistic children and slow learners. Over 85% of the artwork is created by autistic children, leveraging their natural inclination towards colours, art, craft, and motor skills. AARAMBH ART ZONE presents a range of artefacts, and every purchase contributes towards the organisation's vision of achieving self-sustainable economic independence, promoting mainstream inclusion for these children, and building their confidence.
